data.gender_notes: Harriott is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word ‘hare’ which means ‘hare’ and ‘weard’ meaning ‘guard’ or ‘man’. The name Harriott can be interpreted as ‘Free man’ or ‘Horse guard’. In Christian symbolism, horses represent humility and strength. The name Harriott carries the meaning “Free man or horse” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Harriott usually hope their child will grow to embody free man or horse and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Harriott belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Free man or horse.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harriott total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: האריוט
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נשי שמשמעותו שליט הבית או שולטת הבית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם האריוט מקורו במילה העברית 'שרה' שמשמעותה גברת הבית או שליטת הבית. הוא קשור למילה 'האר' שפירושה שר או אדון, ו'יוט' שפירושה בת או צאצא. השם משמש כנראה לציון אישה בעלת מעמד גבוה או אישה אצילה.

in_greek.name: Χάρριος
in_greek.meaning: Όνομα γυναικείο που σημαίνει κυρία του σπιτιού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Χάρριος προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'χάρης' που σημαίνει χάρη ή γλυκύτητα, και πιθανόν από το 'γυνή' που σημαίνει γυναίκα. Στον ελληνικό πολιτισμό, το όνομα Χάρριος συνδέεται με την έννοια της γυναικείας χάρης και της ομορφιάς.

in_latin.name: Harriott
in_latin.meaning: Feminine name meaning ruler of the house or estate
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Harriott is derived from the Old English words 'har' meaning house or estate and 'riott' meaning ruler or governor. In Christian tradition, the name Harriott signifies a woman of authority and leadership, reflecting the virtues of wisdom, compassion, and strength.

The name "hare" is reminiscent of the biblical figure of the hare as a symbol of the quickness of the Holy Spirit. This name is also associated with humility, strength, and protection as symbols of the Christian faith.
